title: Why Cem Karsan Says Stocks Ignore a Bond Market in Free Fall
speaker: Cem Karsan (Kai Media), with Jermal Chandler (tastylive)

macro_themes.view: Administration (Treasury buybacks, oil jawboning, friendly payrolls) is propping equities until the Nov 3 midterms; incentive ends after.
Long end breaking out structurally (refinancing wall, AI capex crowding out credit, Hormuz inflation, foreign buyer strike); without intervention yields go to 6-7%.
Expects large long-end QE/yield-curve facility sometime between the midterms and June 2027, likely triggered by a crisis, plus sovereign wealth fund buying stocks.
MOVE and CDS rising while equity vol is suppressed; equity vol should catch up.

calls.condition: Up into the midterms; after the midterms authorities step away and a 25-40% decline is likely; if no crisis comes, QE at all-time highs keeps the market screaming.
calls.reason: Equity strength is manufactured by Treasury/administration levers that end at the midterms while the bond market is already in crisis.
calls.quote: I've been very adamant, they can control this very well for 4 weeks.

calls.reason: Refinancing of 2020-21 debt, AI capex borrowing crowding out, structural Hormuz inflation and international buyer strike leave no bids for bonds.
calls.quote: Otherwise, it is a non-stop move. Not to Not to six. To seven. Okay? That's where this bond market's going without intervention.

calls.reason: Equity vol suppressed while MOVE index and credit default swaps rise; underlying vol to express itself once management stops after midterms.
calls.quote: The reality is there is a real suppression of equity volatility.

notes: Date from 'midterm election 28 days away' (Nov 3, 2026) -> 2026-10-06, matches listing; refers to today's close up 60+ points. 10y at ~20-year high and DXY at 17-month high noted without forecast. Yield targets 6/7 are 'without intervention' levels, not unconditional targets. Host Jermal's name transcribed 'Jamal'; Cem called 'Jim'.
